articles.title: Detroit TV anchor caught calling her boss a ‘bitch’ during explosive newsroom meltdown
articles.standfirst: The behind-the-scenes video shows Taryn Asher exploding at a colleague, but the tense moment has now resurfaced in the middle of a much bigger legal battle with Fox
articles.summary: The behind-the-scenes video shows Taryn Asher exploding at a colleague, but the tense moment has now resurfaced in the middle of a much bigger legal battle with Fox
articles.body:
A behind-the-scenes video from a Detroit newsroom is drawing attention after veteran TV anchor Taryn Asher was caught losing her temper and calling a colleague a “bitch” while cameras were still rolling.

The footage shows Asher preparing to record a PSA at WJBK-TV Fox 2 Detroit when a disagreement over scripts and the workflow begins to escalate. After complaining about the situation, Asher watches the colleague walk away and says, “Bitch.” Moments later, she adds, “What the f--k. Grow up,” before saying she is “so done with her antics” and accusing the woman of “telling on me every five seconds.”

The newsroom confrontation turns ugly

But the uncomfortable video has resurfaced in the middle of a much bigger fight between Asher and her former employer. The longtime anchor, who joined Fox 2 in 2007 and became a lead evening anchor, was removed from the air in November 2025. Fox says the decision followed repeated complaints about what it characterized as workplace “outbursts” and unprofessional behavior.

Asher tells a very different story. She is suing Fox Television Stations and New World Communications of Detroit for sex discrimination and retaliation, alleging she was treated less favorably than male colleagues and punished after raising concerns about unequal treatment.

Her lawsuit specifically claims male co-anchor Roop Raj received more guest-interview opportunities and greater scheduling flexibility.

Fox disputes those allegations and says Asher's removal was about her conduct, not her gender. According to the station's account reported by the New York Post , several employees complained about her behavior shortly before she was placed on leave, including allegations of shouting, profanity and confrontational interactions with coworkers.

Asher's attorneys argue the viral clip does not tell the full story. They say the confrontation shown in the video happened years earlier, had already been addressed at the time and was not what caused her eventual removal.

Her lawsuit also alleges that male Fox employees accused of serious workplace misconduct received less severe punishment allegations the company disputes.

That leaves the explosive newsroom footage with a very different significance. What looks like a few seconds of an anchor losing her cool is now evidence in the public battle over why Asher's nearly two-decade career at Fox 2 Detroit came to an abrupt end with Fox pointing to her behavior and Asher arguing that discrimination and retaliation were really behind her departure.

articles.title: Meghan Markle's return to acting with Netflix is canceled just 24 hours after being made official
articles.standfirst: Guy Ritchie abruptly dispenses with her services
articles.summary: Guy Ritchie abruptly dispenses with her services
articles.body:
After nine years, Meghan Markle was set to resume her acting career . The wife of England’s Prince Harry was reportedly going to take part in the third season of Netflix’s ‘The Gentlemen’ , under Guy Ritchie. However, just 24 hours after it became official, the outlet Fresh Hell announced that the decision to cast the actress had been canceled.

Apparently, the intense criticism received from the United Kingdom once Markle's involvement became known, put Guy Ritchie in a difficult position, and he chose to remove the actress from the project and abruptly leave her out of the Netflix series, whose filming had begun last August 21.

According to rumors, Markle had secured a meeting to join ‘The Gentlemen’ thanks to “mutual friends” and with the desire to resume her career , which she had put on hold after joining the British Royal Family. In 2020, following Prince Harry’s resignation, Markle has had many doors closed to her in the industry.

Harry and Meghan's return to England

On the other hand, World of Reel points out that this entire incident would be nothing more than a stratagem in line with the intentions of the Dukes of Sussex to return to England in the short term . Apparently, the actress would like to stand in front of the cameras again, and to do so she would seek to settle back in her country.

Be that as it may, the truth is that Prince Harry still retains his position in the line of succession to the throne , which his brother William will occupy when King Charles III passes away. The relationship between the brothers, in any case, is nonexistent, and the rumors of his return have once again reopened the controversies surrounding the Duke and Duchess of Sussex and their departure from active life within the British Royal Family.

articles.title: Who is the dancer who won Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro and what prize did she receive?
articles.standfirst: The first season of the spin-off has come to an end, and now there is a winner with a prize that could completely change her future on television.
articles.summary: The first season of the spin-off has come to an end, and now there is a winner with a prize that could completely change her future on television.
articles.body:
After eight weeks of competition, Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro has its first champion . Monday's grand finale, August 31, left one dancer at the top and, with it, opened the doors directly to one of the most important stages in American television.

Her name is Adele Zaikman, she is 24 years old, and she was born and raised in Rishon LeZion, Israel . Her parents are Ukrainian, and in addition to growing up speaking Russian and Hebrew, she is also fluent in English. Three years ago, she moved to Los Angeles to take her dance career to an international stage.

But getting here was far from easy. Adele began dancing at six years old, and when she was 13, she was diagnosed with severe scoliosis . Her treatment included an orthopedic brace that she had to wear for 20 hours a day, putting her future in dance at risk. She used the four hours she could spend without it to train, keeping her dream alive until, years later, it brought her to Dancing with the Stars.

From “Rolls-Royce” to champion

In the finale, Adele competed alongside Nev Schulman, best known as the host of Catfish: The TV Show and a former DWTS contestant. Together, they performed a samba to “Bun Up the Dance” by Dillon Francis and Skrillex before closing with a freestyle set to “Natural” by Imagine Dragons . The result ultimately confirmed what the judges had seen from the beginning: Adele had something that made her stand out among the finalists.

So, how much money did she win after this victory?

Here is the detail that may surprise many viewers: Adele did not receive a cash prize whose amount has been publicly announced . The reward for winning The Next Pro is much more specific: she earned a spot as a professional dancer on season 35 of Dancing with the Stars.

In other words, the grand prize was not a briefcase full of money, but a professional opportunity within the main franchise . Although DWTS professional dancers are paid for their participation, the amount Adele will earn has not been established in the available information, so it would not be accurate to attribute a specific figure to her.

Her next step is already set: season 35 of Dancing with the Stars will begin on September 15, and Adele will join the main cast after becoming the first champion of The Next Pro.
